sanskrit: prasthāpya tu sa śatrughnaṃ bhrātṛbhyāṃ saha rāghavaḥ pramumoda sukhī rājyaṃ dharmeṇa paripālayan
english: Having dispatched Śatrughna along with his brothers, Rāghava rejoiced contentedly, governing the kingdom by righteousness.

sanskrit: tataḥ katipayāhaḥsu vṛddho jānapado dvijaḥ śavaṃ bālam upādāya rājadvāram upāgamat
english: Then, after a few days, an aged brahmin of the land came to the royal gate, bearing the corpse of a child.

sanskrit: rudan bahuvidhā vācaḥ snehākṣarasamanvitāḥ asakṛt putraputreti vākyam etad uvāca ha
english: Weeping, he uttered manifold words filled with tears of affection, crying out again and again, "My son, my son!"

sanskrit: kiṃ nu me duṣkṛtaṃ karma pūrvaṃ dehāntare kṛtam yad ahaṃ putram ekaṃ tvāṃ paśyāmi nidhanaṃ gatam
english: "What evil deed did I commit in a former body in a previous life, that I now see you, my only son, gone to death?"

sanskrit: aprāptayauvanaṃ bālaṃ pañcavarṣasamanvitam akāle kālam āpannaṃ duḥkhāya mama putraka
english: "A child who had not yet reached youth, only five years of age — you have met death untimely, for my grief, O my dear son."

sanskrit: alpair ahobhir nidhanaṃ gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ahaṃ ca jananī caiva tava śokena putraka
english: "Without doubt, within a few days I and your mother shall both go to death, slain by grief for you, O my son."

sanskrit: na smarāmy anṛtaṃ hy uktaṃ na ca hiṃsāṃ smarāmy aham kena me duṣkṛtenādya bāla eva mamātmajaḥ akṛtvā pitṛkāryāṇi nīto vaivasvatakṣayam
english: "I do not recall having spoken falsehood, nor do I recall having done harm — by what evil deed of mine has my son, while yet a child, been carried to the abode of Vaivasvata without having performed the rites due to his forefathers?"

sanskrit: nedṛśaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ me śrutaṃ vā ghoradarśanam mṛtyur aprāptakālānāṃ rāmasya viṣaye yathā
english: "Never before have I seen or heard of so dreadful a sight — the death of those who have not yet reached their time, in Rāma's kingdom."

sanskrit: rāmasya duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃ cin mahad asti na saṃśayaḥ tvaṃ rājañ jīvayasvainaṃ bālaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gatam
english: "Without doubt some great sin has been committed by Rāma. O king, restore this child to life who has fallen under the sway of death."

sanskrit: bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rājan dīrgham āyur avāpnuhi uṣitāḥ sma sukhaṃ rājye tavāsmin sumahābala
english: "O king of great might, may you attain long life together with your brothers. We have lived happily in your kingdom."

sanskrit: saṃpraty anātho viṣaya ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahātmanām rāmaṃ nātham ihāsādya bālāntakaraṇaṃ nṛpam
english: "Now the realm of the great-souled Ikṣvākus is left without a protector, having found in Rāma a king who brings about the death of children."

sanskrit: rājadoṣair vipadyante prajā hy avidhipālitāḥ asadvṛtte tu nṛpatāv akāle mriyate janaḥ
english: "The subjects perish through the faults of a king when they are not protected according to proper law; and when a king is of wicked conduct, people die before their time."

sanskrit: yadā pureṣv ayuktāni janā janapadeśu ca kurvate na ca rakṣāsti tadākālakṛtaṃ bhayam
english: "When people in cities and in the countryside commit unlawful acts and there is no protection, then comes the calamity wrought by untimely death."

sanskrit: savyaktaṃ rājadoṣo 'yaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ pure janapade vāpi tadā bālavadho hy ayam
english: "This killing of a child — whether in the city or in the country — shall without doubt plainly prove to be the king's fault."

sanskrit: evaṃ bahuvidhair vākyair nindayāno muhur muhuḥ rājānaṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptaḥ sutaṃ tam upagūhati
english: Thus, with many such words, again and again blaming the king, tormented by grief, he embraced his son.

sanskrit: tathā tu karuṇaṃ tasya dvijasya paridevitam śuśrāva rāghavaḥ sarvaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitam
english: Rāghava heard all of that pitiful lamentation of the brahmin, filled with pain and grief.

sanskrit: sa duḥkhena susaṃtapto mantriṇaḥ samupāhvayat vasiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca bhrātṝṃś ca sahanaigamān
english: Deeply afflicted by sorrow, he summoned his ministers, Vasiṣṭha, Vāmadeva, his brothers, and the guild leaders together.

sanskrit: tato dvijā vasiṣṭhena sārdham aṣṭau praveśitāḥ rājānaṃ devasaṃkāśaṃ vardhasveti tato 'bruvan
english: Then eight brahmins were ushered in together with Vasiṣṭha; they said to the king, who was resplendent as a god, "May you be well."

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeyo 'tha maudgalyo vāmadevaś ca kāśyapaḥ kātyāyano 'tha jābālir gautamo nāradas tathā
english: They were Mārkaṇḍeya, Maudgalya, Vāmadeva, Kāśyapa, Kātyāyana, Jābāli, Gautama, and likewise Nārada.

sanskrit: ete dvijarṣabhāḥ sarve āganeṣūpaveśitāḥ mantriṇo naigamāś caiva yathārham anukūlataḥ
english: All these foremost among the twice-born were seated in the assembly fires, and the ministers and guild leaders likewise took their places as was fitting.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dīptatejasām raghavaḥ sarvam ācaṣṭe dvijo yasmāt praroditi
english: When all of them, blazing with splendor, had taken their seats, Rāghava related everything — the reason why the brahmin was weeping.

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rājño dīnasya nāradaḥ pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyam ṛṣīṇāṃ saṃnidhau nṛpam
english: Hearing that speech of the distressed king, Nārada replied with an auspicious word to the king in the presence of the sages.

sanskrit: śṛṇu rājan yathākāle prāpto 'yaṃ bālasaṃkṣayaḥ śrutvā kartavyatāṃ vīra kuruṣva raghunandana
english: "Hear, O king, how this destruction of a child has come about in this age. Having heard, O hero, O delight of the Raghu line, do what must be done."

sanskrit: purā kṛtayuge rāma brāhmaṇā vai tapasvinaḥ abrāhmaṇas tadā rājan na tapasvī kathaṃ cana
english: "In the Kṛta age of old, O Rāma, only brahmins were ascetics; in that age, O king, no one who was not a brahmin was an ascetic under any circumstances."

sanskrit: tasmin yuge prajvalite brahmabhūte anāvṛte amṛtyavas tadā sarve jajñire dīrghadarśinaḥ
english: In that age, blazing with brahmic power, unclouded, all were immortal and far-sighted in birth.

sanskrit: tatas tretāyugaṃ nāma mānavānāṃ vapuṣmatām kṣatriyā yatra jāyante pūrveṇa tapasānvitāḥ
english: Then came the age known as the Tretā, of embodied human beings, wherein kṣatriyas are born, endowed with the austerity of a prior birth.

sanskrit: vīryeṇa tapasā caiva te 'dhikāḥ pūrvajanmani mānavā ye mahātmānas tasmiṃs tretāyuge yuge
english: Those great-souled humans who excelled by valor and austerity in a previous birth — it was they who lived in that Tretā age.

sanskrit: brahmakṣatraṃ tu tat sarvaṃ yat pūrvam aparaṃ ca yat yugayor ubhayor āsīt samavīryasamanvitam
english: All that brahmin and kṣatriya order — whatever existed in both the earlier and the latter of those two ages — was of equal power and endowed with equal might.

sanskrit: apaśyantas tu te sarve viśeṣam adhikaṃ tataḥ sthāpanaṃ cakrire tatra cāturvarṇyasya sarvataḥ
english: Yet seeing no further special distinction therein, they then established everywhere the institution of the four varṇas.

sanskrit: adharmaḥ pādam ekaṃ tu pātayat pṛthivītale adharmeṇa hi saṃyuktās tena mandābhavan dvijāḥ
english: Then adharma cast one foot upon the earth; and because the twice-born became associated with adharma, they grew dull.

sanskrit: tataḥ prāduṣkṛtaṃ pūrvam āyuṣaḥ pariniṣṭhitam śubhāny evācaraṃl lokāḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ
english: Then a limit was established for the span of life, and people, devoted to truth and righteousness, practiced only virtuous deeds.

sanskrit: tretāyuge tv avartanta brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyaś ca ye tapo 'tapyanta te sarve śuśrūṣām apare janāḥ
english: In the Tretā age, while brahmins and kṣatriyas practiced austerity, the remaining people rendered service.

sanskrit: sa dharmaḥ paramas teṣāṃ vaiśyaśūdram athāgamat pūjāṃ ca sarvavarṇānāṃ śūdrāś cakrur viśeṣataḥ
english: That supreme dharma then came down to the vaiśya and śūdra; and śūdras especially performed worship on behalf of all the varṇas.

sanskrit: tataḥ pādam adharmasya dvitīyam avatārayat tato dvāparasaṃkhyā sā yugasya samajāyata
english: Then adharma set down its second foot, and thereupon arose that age reckoned as the Dvāpara.

sanskrit: tasmin dvāparasaṃkhye tu vartamāne yugakṣaye adharmaś cānṛtaṃ caiva vavṛdhe puruṣarṣabha
english: In that age numbered as the Dvāpara, as the yuga drew toward its end, adharma and untruth both increased, O bull among men.

sanskrit: tasmin dvāparasaṃkhyāte tapo vaiśyān samāviśat na śūdro labhate dharmam ugraṃ taptaṃ nararṣabha
english: In that same Dvāpara age, austerity entered into the vaiśyas; a śūdra does not attain the fierce austerity of dharma, O bull among men.

sanskrit: hīnavarṇo naraśreṣṭha tapyate sumahat tapaḥ bhaviṣyā śūdrayonyāṃ hi tapaścaryā kalau yuge
english: One born in a lower varṇa, O best of men, will practice very great austerity — for the practice of austerity by those born in a śūdra womb shall come in the Kali age."

sanskrit: adharmaḥ paramo rāma dvāpare śūdradhāritaḥ sa vai viṣayaparyante tava rājan mahātapāḥ śūdras tapyati durbuddhis tena bālavadho hy ayam
english: "Supreme adharma in the Dvāpara, O Rāma, rests upon a śūdra. Indeed, O king, at the border of your realm there is a śūdra of wicked mind practicing great austerity — it is because of him that this death of a child has come about."

sanskrit: yo hy adharmam akāryaṃ vā viṣaye pārthivasya hi karoti rājaśārdūla pure vā durmatir naraḥ kṣipraṃ hi narakaṃ yāti sa ca rājā na saṃśayaḥ
english: "For whatever wicked-minded man commits adharma or an unlawful act in the realm of a king, whether in the city — that man quickly goes to hell, as does the king himself, without doubt."

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla mārgasva viṣayaṃ svakam duṣkṛtaṃ yatra paśyethās tatra yatnaṃ samācara
english: "Therefore, O tiger among men, search your own realm; wherever you find wrongdoing, there make every effort to act."

sanskrit: evaṃ te dharmavṛddhiś ca nṛṇāṃ cāyurvivardhanam bhaviṣyati naraśreṣṭha bālasyāsya ca jīvitam
english: "Thus there shall be for you an increase of dharma, a lengthening of people's lifespan, O best of men, and the restoration of life to this child."

sanskrit: nāradasya tu tad vākyaṃ śrutvāmṛtamayaṃ yathā praharṣam atulaṃ lebhe lakṣmaṇaṃ cedam abravīt
english: Having heard Nārada's words, which were as if full of nectar, he felt incomparable joy, and spoke these words to Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: gaccha saumya dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ samāśvāsaya lakṣmaṇa bālasya ca śarīraṃ tat tailadroṇyāṃ nidhāpaya
english: "Go, dear Lakṣmaṇa, comfort the foremost brahmin, and place that child's body in a vessel of oil."

sanskrit: gandhaiś ca paramodārais tailaiś ca susugandhibhiḥ yathā na kṣīyate bālas tathā saumya vidhīyatām
english: "With the most excellent fragrant substances and with sweet-smelling oils, let it be arranged, dear one, so that the child does not deteriorate."

sanskrit: yathā śarīre bālasya guptasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ vipattiḥ paribhedo vā bhaven na ca tathā kuru
english: "Act in such a way that no decay or decomposition comes to the body of the child who is thus preserved, O one of unblemished deeds."

sanskrit: tathā saṃdiśya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam manasā puṣpakaṃ dadhyāv āgaccheti mahāyaśāḥ
english: Having so instructed Lakṣmaṇa of auspicious marks, the great-famed Kākutstha, the scion of Kakutstha's line, mentally called upon the Puṣpaka, thinking, "Come."

sanskrit: iṅgitaṃ sa tu vijñāya puṣpako hemabhūṣitaḥ ājagāma muhūrtena saṃpīpaṃ rāghavasya vai
english: Understanding that sign, the golden-adorned Puṣpaka came within a moment to the presence of Rāghava.

sanskrit: so 'bravīt praṇato bhūtvā ayam asmi narādhipa vaśyas tava mahābāho kiṃkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ
english: Bowing down, it said: "Here I am, O lord of men. I, your obedient servant, am present, O mighty-armed one."

sanskrit: bhāṣitaṃ ruciraṃ śrutvā puṣpakasya narādhipaḥ abhivādya maharṣīs tān vimānaṃ so 'dhyarohata
english: Hearing the pleasant words of Puṣpaka, the lord of men saluted those great sages and boarded the celestial chariot.

sanskrit: dhanur gṛhītvā tūṇīṃ ca khagdaṃ ca ruciraprabham nikṣipya nagare vīrau saumitribharatāv ubhau
english: Taking his bow, his quiver, and his sword of brilliant radiance, having left in the city both heroes — Saumitri and Bharata —

sanskrit: prāyāt pratīcīṃ sa marūn vicinvaṃś ca samantataḥ uttarām agamac chrīmān diśaṃ himavadāvṛtam
english: — he set out toward the west, searching the desert regions on all sides, and then the glorious one went to the northern direction, girt by the Himālayas.

sanskrit: apaśyamānas tatrāpi svalpam apy atha duṣkṛtam pūrvām api diśaṃ sarvām athāpaśyan narādhipaḥ
english: Finding not even the slightest wrongdoing there either, the lord of men then surveyed the entire eastern direction as well.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ākrāmat tato rājarṣinandanaḥ śaivalasyottare pārśve dadarśa sumahat saraḥ
english: Then that son of a royal sage advanced toward the southern direction, and on the northern slope of mount Śaivala he saw a very great lake.

sanskrit: tasmin sarasi tapyantaṃ tāpasaṃ sumahat tapaḥ dadarśa rāghavaḥ śrīmāṃl lambamānam adho mukham
english: In that lake, the glorious Rāghava saw an ascetic performing very great austerity, hanging with his face downward.

sanskrit: athainaṃ samupāgamya tapyantaṃ tapa uttamam uvāca rāghavo vākyaṃ dhanyas tvam asi suvrata
english: Approaching him as he practiced the highest austerity, Rāghava spoke these words: "You are blessed, O observer of good vows."

sanskrit: kasyāṃ yonyāṃ tapovṛddhavartase dṛḍhavikrama kautūhalāt tvāṃ pṛcchāmi rāmo dāśarathir hy aham
english: "In what womb were you born, O firm and courageous one, that you advance in austerity? I ask you out of curiosity — I am Rāma, son of Daśaratha."

sanskrit: manīṣitas te ko nv arthaḥ svargalābho varāśrayaḥ yam aśritya tapas taptaṃ śrotum icchāmi tāpasa
english: "What is the desired object you have in mind — the attainment of heaven, or the obtaining of a boon? What purpose have you taken refuge in, for which this austerity has been performed? I wish to hear, O ascetic."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇo vāsi bhadraṃ te kṣatriyo vāsi durjayaḥ vaiśyo vā yadi vā śūdraḥ satyam etad bravīhi me
english: "Are you a brahmin — blessings to you — or an invincible kṣatriya? Are you a vaiśya, or are you a śūdra? Tell me the truth of this."
